parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The URL or IP address that is monitored by the task.

parameters.name: AlertIds
parameters.description: The ID of the alert rule. You can call the DescribeMetricRuleList operation to query the IDs of existing alert rules in CloudMonitor. For more information, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

parameters.name: CustomSchedule
parameters.description: The custom detection period. You can only select a time period from Monday to Sunday for detection.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The interval at which detection requests are sent. Valid values: 1, 5, and 15. Unit: minutes. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: IntervalUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the metric.

Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: IspCities
parameters.description:
The information of the detection points. The value is a JSON array. Example: `[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`. The values of the `city` field indicate Beijing, Hangzhou, and Qingdao.

> You can call the DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList operation to query the detection points. For more information, see [DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList](~~115045~~). If you leave this parameter empty, the system randomly selects three detection points.

parameters.name: OptionsJson
parameters.description: The extended options of the protocol that is used by the site monitoring task. The options vary based on the protocol.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the site monitoring task.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: The name of the site monitoring task. The name must be 4 to 100 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms modify-site-monitor --address http://www.aliyun.com --task-id 2c8dbdf9-a3ab-46a1-85a4-f094965e0000 --task-name HanZhou_ECS2 --interval 1 --isp-cities city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465 --options-json time_out_:5000 --alert-ids 49f7c317-7645-4cc9-94fd-ea42e1220000 --interval-unit ms --custom-schedule start_hour_:0,_end_hour_:24,_days_:_0_,_time_zone_:_Local --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms ModifySiteMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --IntervalUnit ms --CustomSchedule 'start_hour_:0,_end_hour_:24,_days_:_0_,_time_zone_:_Local' --TaskId '2c8dbdf9-a3ab-46a1-85a4-f094965e0000' --Address 'http://www.aliyun.com' --TaskName HanZhou_ECS2 --OptionsJson 'time_out_:5000' --IspCities 'city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465' --Interval 1 --AlertIds '49f7c317-7645-4cc9-94fd-ea42e1220000'
